title: Ava Aspetic 10

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What did she say?
And she said nothing?!

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: That sounds like custom programming. The majority of CorpSec arrests are made using artificial intelligence risk algorithms.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds like custom programming. The majority of CorpSec arrests are made using artificial intelligence risk algorithms.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: We shouldn't go together. I'm going to try and give Curzona the runaround - see if I can buy us some time. I'll meet you there. Be quick.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We shouldn't go together. I'm going to try and give Curzona the runaround - see if I can buy us some time. I'll meet you there. Be quick.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: Exactly. As far as I know CorpSec only require a 13% certainty before making an arrest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly. As far as I know CorpSec only require a 13% certainty before making an arrest.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: That was strange, I went offline again. Is that Gamova?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That was strange, I went offline again. Is that Gamova?
Yes.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I thought we were through with her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I thought we were through with her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't have time to explain this but, Ava, do you know who the Aseptic is?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have time to explain this but, Ava, do you know who the Aseptic is?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't have time to explain this but, Ava, do you know who the Aseptic is?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't have time to explain this but, Ava, do you know who the Aseptic is?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I believe so.
Really?!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I'd say my confidence rating is 95%.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd say my confidence rating is 95%.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's quite high. Why haven't you said anything?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's quite high. Why haven't you said anything?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's quite high. Why haven't you said anything?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's quite high. Why haven't you said anything?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Every time I tried to mention it, something inside the network blocked my communication. I assumed it was a failsafe of some kind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Every time I tried to mention it, something inside the network blocked my communication. I assumed it was a failsafe of some kind.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: The network is preventing me from providing a name.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The network is preventing me from providing a name.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?! Our lives are in danger.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?! Our lives are in danger.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What?! Our lives are in danger.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What?! Our lives are in danger.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: There are things I cannot say, even if I want to say them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There are things I cannot say, even if I want to say them.
Is there a workaround?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Hmmm... I was able to track the suspect using a network of TheraPay bots that they interacted with regularly. This gave me an approximate route to their location.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmmm... I was able to track the suspect using a network of TheraPay bots that they interacted with regularly. This gave me an approximate route to their location.
Ok... where did it lead?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I have updated your map. I believe the trail of street-therapy leads to an apartment deep within the Sewers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have updated your map. I believe the trail of street-therapy leads to an apartment deep within the Sewers.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It may be possible for me to bypass the network somehow...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It may be possible for me to bypass the network somehow...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If I guessed the killer, would you be able to tell me if I'm right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I guessed the killer, would you be able to tell me if I'm right?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If I guessed the killer, would you be able to tell me if I'm right?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If I guessed the killer, would you be able to tell me if I'm right?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I am not sure... But we can try!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am not sure... But we can try!
Is it Steven McFellow?
Is it Ma Gomba?
Is it Silo Mills?
Is it Spartacus?
Is it Rheno?
What a great guess!
So... is it!?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Nope. Can't say. This is frustrating.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nope. Can't say. This is frustrating.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Come on, Ava! What about a location?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Come on, Ava! What about a location?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Come on, Ava! What about a location?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Come on, Ava! What about a location?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Was it me?
So who is it?!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She knows who the Aseptic is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She knows who the Aseptic is.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She knows who the Aseptic is.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She knows who the Aseptic is.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: According to Ava, she is unable to make accusations without the network blocking her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: According to Ava, she is unable to make accusations without the network blocking her.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: According to Ava, she is unable to make accusations without the network blocking her.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: According to Ava, she is unable to make accusations without the network blocking her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: All she could give me was an address. You should have it now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All she could give me was an address. You should have it now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: All she could give me was an address. You should have it now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: All she could give me was an address. You should have it now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is it Gunger Hahn?
Who else?
I knew you knew!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You could have told me earlier.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You could have told me earlier.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You could have told me earlier.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You could have told me earlier.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And the failsafe is gone?
What about clues?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I was right! ...Can you tell me if I was right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was right! ...Can you tell me if I was right?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I was right! ...Can you tell me if I was right?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I was right! ...Can you tell me if I was right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Come on Ava.
Why would anyone ... oh!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Somebody didn't trust the authorities, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Somebody didn't trust the authorities, right?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Somebody didn't trust the authorities, right?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Somebody didn't trust the authorities, right?
